method: Official LCSC EasyEDA footprint fitted to the KiCad footprint by numbered pad centroids: quarter-turn rotation (CCW, y up) + least-squares translation; CPL Mid X/Y is the LCSC footprint origin in Gerber-plot coordinates (X=x_kicad-2, Y=79-y_kicad). Pad numbers whose pad count differs between the two footprints are left out of the fit (SOT-223 tab). For polarised parts whose EasyEDA symbol pin names show the pad numbers are electrically swapped against the KiCad netlist, the fit uses the function-matched pads (pad_matching=function; number_match_alternative keeps the r4-style result). Physical PCB unchanged. Supplier preview remains the final check.
